parole.significato: A South American howler monkey (of the genus Alouatta).
parole.testo: From French alouatte, alouate, from a Cariban language; compare Kari'na arawata, Trió arawata, Wayana alawata, Ye'kwana adawa'ta, Apalaí arauta, Akawaio arawta, Pemon arauta, Macushi arauta. Compare araguato.

parole.significato: A South American howler monkey, the ursine howler (Alouatta arctoidea).
parole.testo: From or cognate to French araguate (whence the rare older English spelling araguate), likely from Cariban; compare Kari'na arawata and the other cognates listed at alouatte.
